warnings.message: Same full target sentence is reused across multiple scored activities.

manualReview.scope: Model/editor semantic and pedagogy review of Lesson 0111; not an independent human or real-learner test.

englishNaturalness.evidence: ‘What do you mean?’ and ‘I mean this part.’ are natural short uses of the intended sense.

persianMeaningQuality.evidence: Persian wording preserves the intended meaning of mean as conveying an intended message.

pedagogicalClarity.evidence: One lexical sense moves from recognition to guided exchange, transfer and hidden retrieval.

distractorQuality.evidence: Distractors contrast nearby curriculum targets rather than arbitrary strings.

dialoguePlausibility.evidence: A confusing message naturally motivates asking what someone means.

difficultyFit.evidence: The question form is familiar and learner turns remain short for A1.

repetitionUsefulness.evidence: mean recurs in listening, recognition, guided production and retrieval.

transferQuality.evidence: The second learner turn changes from asking about intent to identifying the intended part.

overallCoherence.evidence: Scenario and assessment remain within one bounded meaning of mean.

learnerExperience.evidence: No real learner test is claimed.

limitations: No independent human or learner test has been performed.
Only the intended/conveyed meaning sense of mean is reviewed.
Audio prosody is not evaluated at this text stage.
resolvedFindings: Final retrieval is hidden before attempt.
Character pair and learner role rotate from the previous Lesson.
